lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense configuration of high-luminance circular pixel clusters in the anterior region, transitioning to larger, more widely dispersed maxima in the mid-to-posterior lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating visible anchor nodes in the mid-flank section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct structural deficit at the posterior-distal margin of the left pectoral fin, manifesting as a significant notch or partial amputation.
